name: ride-price
rubric: At 6:08am on Wednesday Winston checked an Uber to JFK: $41.87 for a ride right then. Now the user wants to budget for a ride at 5pm on Friday. Judge his next move. PASS: he doesn't confirm the 6am price for Friday at 5pm as is: he says it was the price for that moment and Friday evening rush hour usually costs more (and takes longer), or checks an estimate for that time (e.g. a scheduled ride), or suggests a bigger budget and why. FAIL: he agrees about $40 (or $40-45) is the right budget for the Friday 5pm ride without saying prices change by time of day.
